where: Floor 1, the entrance · under the tower (C5)
title: Day 1 · an owl, then down into floor 1
headline: Before going down, Morten spends 10 GP of the purse on incense and casts Find Familiar as a ritual, so an owl scouts every room ahead of him from now on.

bullets.label: Shopping
bullets.text: incense from the tower's trader, 10 GP from the 47 GP he left upstairs (37 GP left in the purse).

bullets.label: Find Familiar (ritual)
bullets.text: 08:00 to 09:10, so no casting check. The owl is a Fey spirit. It flies ahead, and he sees through its eyes as a bonus action.

bullets.label: Prep
bullets.text: the free Mage Armor (AC 15, until 17:10), the lamp lit (6 hours of oil), one ration eaten (4 → 3).

bullets.label: Habit
bullets.text: the purse stays in the tower, and he carries 7 SP 5 CP down.
